discussion.body: Ash Korv. Main-side. Breakwoods / Brass Lands. Half-orc beast-knight. The Invasion is hunger and displacement, not a race verdict. Joins Act 5 when the party refuses the Breskshire kill-order on the holdfast. Death crises: accept the kill-order (Ash dies fighting the party or is hanged); fail the holdfast defense. Default: refuse the order, hold the fort, Ash lives. Contingency: a dying runner still opens the Fire road. If dead, Temple of Fire has no living border-guide.
